[[Mutu Wahmeh]] is the honorable eldest child of [[Nehbawa Wahmeh]], a well-respected elder of the farming village in Issnur Isles. His younger sister is [[Misela Wahmeh|Misela]] and his younger brother is [[Jedur Wahmeh|Jedur]].

==Dialogue==
:''"Long have I trained to become a [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspear]]. My father greatly respected the Order. I only wish he could have lived long enough to see me join. He shall surely smile from [[the Mists]] on the day I prove worthy of that honor."''

During quest [[Mutu, the Oldest Child]]:
:''"If we recover the inheritance, I shall use it for training, weapons, and armor. Once properly equipped and trained, I plan to apply to the Sunspears. I am certain if I try hard enough I will master their challenges and be accepted. My father greatly respected the Order, and I want to honor him by helping them protect the [[Istan]]i people he cared for so deeply."''

After quest [[Mutu, the Oldest Child]]:
:''"My friend, <character name>! I am proud to tell you that I have been accepted into the Order of the Sunspears! I now bear the banner of the protectors of Istan and [[Elona]]! Your nobility, unselfishness, and honor shall be my example of how to live as a dedicated Sunspear. Thank you again, friend, for all you have taught me and for helping me realize my dream. Surely, my father smiles down upon us both."''
